dialogues.speaker: Netsuke no Gen Crafts Advertisement Board
dialogues.text: Our shop specializes in netsuke handed down through the generations. They can be quite pricey, and the owner is not very talkative, so we do not accept bargaining. We apologize in advance for any inconvenience caused!

dialogues.speaker: Netsuke no Gen Crafts Advertisement Board
dialogues.text: Other than netsuke, we also make custom paper umbrellas, Shogi sets, Go sets, masks, daruma and household pottery. Prices are reasonable, and quality is guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Netsuke no Gen Crafts Advertisement Board
dialogues.text: We also buy Electro Sigils all year long. Customers can use Electro Sigils to redeem their desired merchandise in our store.
